newsitem.title: INDIA: India likely to woo private funding for state TV.
newsitem.headline: India likely to woo private funding for state TV.

text.p: India's cabinet will be asked to rule on private investment in one of the country's state-run television channels, officials at the Information and Broadcasting Ministry said on Wednesday.

The officials told Reuters that the investment in the Doordarshan 3 (DD3) channel, if approved, would total about three billion rupees ($84 million) and cover 30 transmitters across the country. The officials did not detail a time-frame for the submission to the cabinet.

"If the cabinet gives the go-ahead, then Doordarshan will have to draw up a business plan (and decide) whether the partnership will be on the basis of revenue sharing or time sharing," Information and Broadcasting Secretary N.P. Nawani said.
